<!-- generated by scripts/cli-reference.mjs from `goback docs`; do not edit -->

Manage the store key that encrypts names and contents before upload, and the at-rest key

```sh
goback [global flags] key <command>
```

## key new

Generate a store key file

```sh
goback [global flags] key new [flags] <name>
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out value` | key file to write |  | `store.key` |

## key escrow

Encrypt a store key with a passphrase into an armored age file, which `age -d` can also open; print it, or keep it with the store using --upload

```sh
goback [global flags] key escrow [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--key value` | key file to escrow |  | `store.key` |
| `--passphrase value` | escrow passphrase | `GOBACK_PASSPHRASE` |  |
| `--passphrase-file value` | file holding the escrow passphrase; used when --passphrase is not set | `GOBACK_PASSPHRASE_FILE` |  |
| `--upload` | keep the escrowed key with the --storage store instead of printing it |  |  |

## key id

Print a store key's id; the store and the key's escrowed copies refer to the key by this id

```sh
goback [global flags] key id [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--key value` | key file |  | `store.key` |

## key recover

Rebuild a key file from an escrowed key and its passphrase

```sh
goback [global flags] key recover [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--escrow value` | escrowed key file, as printed by key escrow; - reads standard input |  | `-` |
| `--out value` | key file to write |  | `store.key` |
| `--passphrase value` | escrow passphrase | `GOBACK_PASSPHRASE` |  |
| `--passphrase-file value` | file holding the escrow passphrase; used when --passphrase is not set | `GOBACK_PASSPHRASE_FILE` |  |

## key at-rest

Generate or rotate the key that seals the archives of a local, gcs:// or s3:// store

```sh
goback [global flags] key at-rest [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out value` | key file to write |  | `at-rest.key` |
| `--rotate` | add a new primary key to the file; the older keys still open the archives they sealed |  |  |
